notes.title: ACHIEVEMENTS Update! April 18, 2019
notes.content:
We're sorry it has been so long since our last update! We've been hard at work porting our games to other consoles. However, we have some exciting news we'd love to share with all our early access fans!

1. Our achievements update will be live today around 2pm CDT. This will most likely be the last early access update prior to our 1.0 release, expected for next month. Signup for our Gnome News [url=https://www.mowinandthrowingame.com/]HERE[/url] to find out about our post launch plans first!  
2. As promised, Mowin’ & Throwin’ is coming to Nintendo Switch very soon! It will be available as a digital only download on the Nintendo e-shop. Stay tuned to our [url=https://twitter.com/mowinnthrowin?lang=en]Mowin’ & Throwin’ Twitter[/url] page for our upcoming release date announcement.
3. If you haven't had a chance yet, come join us on [url=http://discord.gg/mnt]Discord[/url]! We are posting early concepts of the next project and everyone is welcome to offer feedback! We'd really love to know what you think.

[h1] Achievements Update Features [/h1]
We added 15 more achievements to the game for a total of 20! Good luck to all our achievement hunters! 

We also updated the menus so that all players have control over the menus instead of just player 1.

[h1] Version 0.6 Bug Fixes [/h1]
[list]
[*]Fixed a bug where the mower would stay in tank mode after a player jumps off it
[*]Fixed some collision issues in Turf Warfare that would cause undesired mower behavior 
[*]Fixed a visual bug in Seas the Day 1v1 where the fence was the wrong color
[*]Fixed some audio bugs related to the options menu 
[*]Adjusted the mower in A Lawn Way Down so it is harder to fall into the pit 
[*]Fixed a bug that caused the mower to launch into the air
[*]Reordered the screen resolutions in the options menu so that they are in order from highest to lowest
[*]Fixed a bug where the mushroom particle effect was off center on the gnome when they are riding the mower
[*]Fixed a bug where throwable items would not collide with the middle fence in both versions of Jungle Rumble
[*]Fixed text wrapping bugs in the pre-game instruction menus
[*]Fixed a bug where controllers would vibrate non-stop after interacting with the elevator in Woodland Retreat 
[*]Fixed several issues related to the gamma setup screen
[/list]

[h1] Known Bugs / Issues [/h1]
[list]
[*] The gnomes walk much slower than intended when crossing the bridge in Jungle Rumble on certain hardware
[/list]

notes.title: BETA Ends July 24th! Thank You Testers!
notes.content:
[h1] Greetings BETA Gnomies! [/h1]

On behalf of all the developers at House Pixel Games, thank you for your continued feedback and support! Since we began our BETA program in January, we received emails from 4,894 potential testers. We sent out 1,447 BETA keys and had an active tester pool of 531! During that time we fully squashed 301 bugs! 

As we make our final preparations for early access, we have stopped accepting applications for the BETA. The BETA program will end on July 24th; existing BETA keys will function until that date. 

To show our immense gratitude, we’ve decided to giveaway some FREE copies of the FULL RELEASE version of Mowin’ & Throwin’. We’ll be sending details about the giveaway by email next week. Stay tuned!

Our release build has been approved by the fine folks at Valve! Getting excited for the 26th!

Happy Friday!

tags.bug: - During that time we fully squashed 301 bugs!

notes.title: Closed Beta Update! FOUR New Lawns to Mow!
notes.content:
Greetings Gnomies! 

The devs of House Pixel Games are excited to share with our testing community  four, count em FOUR, new lawn levels! We will continue to polish the visuals and tweak the gameplay balance in our remaining months of development. To do that we need your feedback! 

Click [url=https://docs.google.com/document/d/e/2PACX-1vQg36D6W_ewdZ2iqDhuBQSq1kWR1L1DmEaaw077rp03Ivp6X5avpnkWHFXfEHeHl7sJ8FtFf1g9lrfP/pub]HERE[/url] to see the complete release notes. Steam may claim this link is malicious, but I assure you it is not. 

[h1]New Lawns![/h1]

[b]Gnomie-Go-Round[/b]

Players use buttons to rotate the center piece of their lawn to change the lawn's layout. Players trigger the buttons by walking or mowing over them. Players can also sabotage their neighbor's lawn by throwing items at their neighbor's button to change the layout when they least expect it. 

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32522422/f4a25d55e4661f81a3a6fa92bed712e00953ce8f.jpg[/img]

[b]A Lawn Way Down[/b]

This map features breakable tiles that crumble when Gnomes and Mowers move over them and break when they move off them. Thrown items can also break these tiles, making the level fun to sabotage your neighbor's ability to move around the lawn. Any object on top of a breakable tile when it breaks will fall into the foggy abyss below. Gnomes and Mowers re-spawn and are parachuted back in the game after a few seconds.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32522422/60e322060be48a0cb5541b8df31d176a01314ec2.jpg[/img]


[b]Lagoon Lawn[/b] 

Each team’s lawn consists of a mainland and a stationary island which are temporarily connected by a floating island that rotates around the stationary island. Players that fall or are knocked into the water by thrown objects will respawn after a few seconds.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32522422/7d5fa8ea3dca5e4078e4f144cd6c721104f5a580.jpg[/img]

[b]Tug-of-Chore[/b]

Each lawn has three areas connected by bridges. The bridges are controlled by a massive button in the center which changes color when hit by an object. When the button is blue, the bridges on the blue team’s lawn can be crossed but the red team’s bridges cannot and vice versa. 

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32522422/cbc32b9ba6d4c41d7845698e702733ae05d7c0a5.jpg[/img]


Enjoy!
